adapters.description: Installs to the canonical AI-Verse library, exposes managed entries to the OS Claude/Codex skill surfaces, and writes a derived integration manifest without transferring OS authority to skills.
Expose portable skill package directories to Agent Skills-compatible runtimes.
Link/copy selected installed packages into a user-selected Claude skills directory.
Link/copy selected installed packages into a user-selected Codex skills directory.
Expose packages to a user-selected Hermes skills directory while preserving original package content.
Expose packages to a user-selected OpenClaw skill root; runtime permissions remain OpenClaw-owned.
Expose packages to a user-selected Gemini skill root.

rule: Adapters expose skills; they never grant filesystem scope, secrets, connections, approvals, memory authority, or scheduling.
